{{recipe}}

'''Tempoyak''' is a condiment made of salted fermented [[Cookbook:Durian|durian]]. The salt is used as a preserving agent, so one needs to be generous with it.

==Ingredients==

* 2 large [[Cookbook:Durian|durian]] fruit, flesh removed and seeds discarded
* 4 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]

==Procedure==
#Place the durian flesh in a clean jar. Add salt, then [[Cookbook:Beating|beat]] the mixture until it becomes soft and creamy.
#Close the jar tightly and leave it to [[Cookbook:Fermentation|ferment]] for 1 week. 
#The fermented durian can be kept in the refrigerator for up to a year.
